summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark, particularly regarding improvements for small file workloads and support for variant types. Additionally, proposals for fine-grained access control in REST catalogs and enhancements to the OpenAPI specification for Basic Authentication have been introduced.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal for Fine Grained Access Control in REST catalogs
Adding Basic Authentication to OpenAPI Specification
Exploring parallel task execution in Spark readers
